Zener diodes are designed to operate in the "break down" condition. Break down voltage will not harm the zener.
The junction diode is not designed to "break down" and may be damaged.
Too much reverse bias will "break down" the junction diode and current will flow in the wrong direction.
A junction diode acts like an open switch when reverse biased. Current will not flow.
